lines.text: *Vroooooom!*
Black Typhoon, carrying Sugar and Moran, races through the Outer Rim.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey, what the heck do you think you're doing?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Found Sixo's base, I think.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: We're heading there now.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Thought I'd put on a little act to throw her off.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Not bad, huh? Could've snagged Best Actress, right?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How'd you find it?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Sixo reached out, asking if I'd keep taking jobs guarding the Mist production facilities.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I was about to blow her off without a second thought,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: but then that saying popped into my head: "To catch a tiger, you have to enter its den."

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: So I told her I'd do it.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I worked my butt off,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: and that's when I started thinking she wasn't human or a Nikke.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Then seeing her give different orders to twenty-three locations at once confirmed my suspicions.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If she's not human or a Nikke, what else could she be? Some kind of virtual human, obviously.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Virtual human?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The fact that no one had seen her true form made me even more suspicious.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: So I checked every wire in all twenty-three Mist production facilities.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If she's a virtual human, she'd definitely travel through the wires.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: That makes sense!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The Outer Rim's wiring is a mess. Everything's all tangled up. You can't tell where it starts or ends.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Still, I checked.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If even one wire from each of the twenty-three production facilities led to the same place,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I figured that's where Sixo would be.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I dug into the ground a little at a time, on the sly.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Kept looking, even while I was on protection duty.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So... did you find it?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah, I found it.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Each of the twenty-three Mist production facilities has a single wire

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: that leads to the same place.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: And that's where we're headed.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: This is the closest I've ever gotten since I could have been discovered.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I didn't want to go alone, so I brought you along.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: ... I guess two are better than one.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: But I still can't forgive what you did.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah, my bad...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I shouldn't have doubted you.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: What happened to the Peony Association is largely my fault. I'm sorry about that too.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If someone had no choice but to take that job, I won't turn my back on them. Not now. Not ever.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: And when someone ends up stuck in crap they didn't choose,

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: someone's gotta pull them out.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If they didn't know it was wrong, then that's the right thing to do.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: But if someone does it knowing it's wrong, I'd make the same choice too.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah...

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That's why Sixo has to be taken down.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: She's the one who creates the filth and drags desperate people into it without a second thought.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: We have to get rid of her.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: The Scavengers also take cleanup jobs, you know.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So who requested this?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Consider it a volunteer gig.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Nice one, Scavenger.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Hmm, there's a tunnel up ahead.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Perfect place for a base.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: ... All right, let's keep moving.
*Vroooooom!*
Black Typhoon tears ahead even faster.
*Vroooooom!*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: ... Is it just me, or is it getting kind of warm in here?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah, the temp just shot up.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Are you sure we're at the right place? There aren't any guards or anything.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: ... If she's that meticulous, she wouldn't have put anyone in such an important position.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: You never know where the information might leak.
*Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz, bzzz*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wait a sec, I'm getting tons of messages. Looks like Jin might be in some kind of trouble.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Ignore them. I'm getting them too.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: What? The messages?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah, it's definitely Sixo.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That means we're at the right place.
*Bzzz, bzzz, bzzz, bzzz*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: ... Maybe we should at least check what it says?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: No, she's obviously going to threaten us and make us fight each other or back down.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I can handle it.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Don't look. There's no telling what's in there.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: You won't be able to ignore it if you do. That's what Sixo's good at.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Let's just keep going.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You've got guts.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: That's why I fought you.
*Vroooooom!*
Black Typhoon barrels through the tunnel, wind whipping past. Moran feels the heat rising, pressing against her skin.
Rows of monitors line the walls,
their screens flashing with endless streams of letters, but she can't make out a single one at this speed.
*Vroooooom!*
Just then, a second bike rumbles from behind.
Moran twists her head to look.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wh-what?! Someone's chasing us!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Probably one of Sixo's lackeys.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Damn, they're fast. We might get caught up soon.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Not a chance.
Black Typhoon accelerates, gaining speed.
The bike behind keeps pace, engines roaring in pursuit.
As the scenery flashes by in streaks,
Moran catches sight of something in the distance:
a huge, yet outdated computer standing tall amidst the chaos.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I-I see a computer!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: This has to be her base.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: So that's Sixo?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Maybe?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Uh... you good with computers?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I know how to play games.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: If it's a computer, we're supposed to, like, hack it or something, right? How are we even supposed to—
*Rat‑tat‑tat‑tat‑tat*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ack!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Tch...!
The pursuing bike roars as Logey sprays bullets.
A shot hits Black Typhoon's rear, ripping a hole straight through the metal frame.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Large caliber weapon... That thing's a Nikke!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Not good. She's catching up.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Looks like she's got a nice ride, but it's still no match for Black Typhoon.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Wh-what do we do?! The computer's right there, and she's still right on our tail!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Time to put our heads together.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Hey, you're going in without any plan?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Nah, Moran. We at least found where the virtual human's base is.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: If we hadn't gone for it, we wouldn't have made it this far.
*Rat‑tat‑tat‑tat‑tat*

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ugh!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Are you okay?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I-I'll be fine...! It only hit my back...

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Ram it!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Smash that computer to pieces!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: I don't know what it is, but it must be important!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Like you said, let's go for it!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Nice. That's a perfect plan.
The pursuing bike surges closer as Logey opens fire.
Gunshots tear through the air, the muzzle fixed on Black Typhoon's engine.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: How dare you!
Moran leaps off Black Typhoon.
Suspended in midair, she swings her fist at Logey.
A shot rings out. Logey fires, the bullet screaming straight toward Moran's punch.
Her fist shatters the round
and drives into Logey's face.
*Craaash!*
The two collide in a tangle of bodies and metal, and Logey's bike spins out, skidding across the ground.
Sugar glances back.
The distance between her and the fallen pair quickly grows.
Then, Moran pushes herself up
and gives Sugar a quick wave.
Sugar smirks slightly and cranks the throttle wide open.
The old computer's monitor looms closer and closer.
At the last second, words flash across the screen.

lines.speaker: sixo
lines.text: I'll make you regret ever being alive.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: What the hell? Spit it out.
*Booooooom!*
A thunderous roar shakes the tunnel.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: ... I never knew a place like this existed.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We ended up taking a very strange route.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Yeah! We squeezed through this tiny hole that barely fit one person, then crawled like maniacs. Man, it was rough!

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: And then, bam! A tunnel suddenly popped up right in front of us.
... Seeing how well it's hidden, it seems like we're in the right place.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Y-yes, there's an old computer just a little further ahead...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: That's where I always got my assignments.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: All right, let's keep going.

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Huh... Aren't there supposed to be guards or something? Boss rooms usually have that kinda stuff.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-it's always been like this. Having guards is a risk in itself...

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Man, her paranoia is seriously next-level.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I guess... that's how she's managed to get this far.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: What about autonomous defense weapons?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: None. She said they use way too much power, and having them around would probably make people suspicious.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You two seem pretty close.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: N-no, not really...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: We just... worked together for a long time.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Figured you might want to know.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Hammering's head got delivered safely.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: We managed to extract all the E2 Crystals, and she'll be getting a new body soon.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: She'll be fine.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Ah... right...

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Um... C-Commander,

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: d-do you think I could... maybe... meet Hammering someday?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I... want to apologize.
It should be fine if she wants to meet.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Right, of course...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Keep at it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Sorry?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Keep owning up to your mistakes and apologizing to everyone you've hurt.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: That's all you can do.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: What if they won't forgive me?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Just keep at it. Whether they forgive you or not is their call.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: But I really can't go on like that my whole life.

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: You'll have to for the rest of your life.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: So... were you forgiven?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Looks like you'll be begging for forgiveness forever, huh?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Mhm.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Is there... any meaning to that?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't know, but we still have to do it.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: So how do you receive forgiveness?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: I don't know that either.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Everyone, stop.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: It's blocked.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Wh-what?
Liveryn takes off running.
... I look ahead.
A solid wall towers in front of me.
The old computer Liveryn mentioned isn't anywhere in sight. There's absolutely nothing here.
Liveryn... don't tell me you...?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: N-no! I swear it was here!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Uh... m-maybe she moved it somewhere?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: I-I'll check again! I can find it, I promise!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Commander...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I don't wish to say this, but she may be stalling for time.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Wait, stalling for time...? N-no, that's not it, I swear!

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Hold on...

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Is that the sound of a motorcycle?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: H-huh?

lines.speaker: eh_n
lines.text: Everyone, get away from the door!
At E.H.'s yell, everyone moves instinctively.
*Booooooom!*
The wall flies apart in the explosion.
Sugar and Black Typhoon burst out of the flames and dust.
Sugar rolls across the floor, then lies still.
Our eyes dart back and forth from the shattered wall to Sugar.

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: Eeep...

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What the...?

lines.speaker: anis_i
lines.text: Wh-whoa! What the hell?!
Sugar!
I dash to Sugar, who shifts her gaze to look at me.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Part...ner...
What on earth happened?!

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: There's something... in my jacket pocket.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Make sure... you keep it safe...
I quickly rummage through Sugar's jacket pocket
and find a small note folded twice.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Please...
Sugar stares straight at me.
I hastily open the note.
Sugar's Coffee Recipe: 1 spoon of coffee, 12 spoons of sugar.
Does this... even count as a recipe...?

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: Yeah, it's a recipe. A special... recipe...
... Get some rest.

lines.speaker: sugar
lines.text: I'll take five.
Sugar closes her eyes.
She looks as though she's sleeping peacefully, yet there's not a single part of her that's unhurt.
At that moment, someone bursts through the smoke.

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Sugar!

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: You idiot, are you... okay...?

lines.speaker: moran
lines.text: Huh? What are you guys doing here...?

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: C-Commander, over here! Over here!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: This is Sixo's computer!

lines.speaker: liveryn
lines.text: It's... broken, though?
What the heck...?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Excuse me.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: The Dark Net has been shut down.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: It appears to be related to you, so I am contacting you regarding this.
